verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS agreement platform like Docusign, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry, analytics, cookie or usage-tracking opt-out control. The breach-related phishing reports concern a different issue and are not relevant to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
